title: Linux on RISC-V (Linux 6.1 + BusyBox)

interactive.steer: serial (UART 16550A receive FIFO, adapter.sendSerial) - the serial console input line

notes: rv32emu-prebuilt 2026.09.23-19f5a79 kernel Image and a busybox initramfs cut from its rootfs (bw-board test/linux-riscv/build.sh), mirrored on branch media/riscv32-linux-v1 and served content-addressed from raw.githubusercontent.com (CORS). Complete corresponding source is on release riscv32-linux-v1. Boots on bw-board RiscV32Machine (64 MiB at 0x80000000, in-emulator SBI) via createDebugTarget('riscv32', {linux}) or runRiscvLinuxBundle; verified by bw-board test/linux-riscv/lesson.mjs. The snapshot is the machine at the prompt after booting them (bw-board createDebugTarget('riscv32', {linux: {kernel, initrd, snapshot}})): the app opens the lesson there; without it, the kernel boots from scratch.

snapshot.base: the RAM bootLinux() lays down for the kernel and initrd slots above
